acceptanceCriteria: corvint index CLI wall time is measured on a quiet host against base ef2a01db5 with the same corpus.
The result is recorded in a build-log entry; if under -20%, a follow-up names the remaining floor.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1470 (idxbuild-1021k, seal 9080ab596, base ef2a01db5). The parallel index build is byte-identical and its in-process median fell 37% under load, but CLI wall time fell only 8% under load. The -20% CLI target has not been shown; the measured floor is leaf openat plus the snapshot gob encode (encoding held by PR #1458).
title: Index build: measure the V1-2285 CLI wall-time target (-20%) on a quiet host
